exact: disruption of host MAP kinase signaling pathway
disruption of host MAPK signal transduction pathway
disruption of host MAPK signaling pathway
symbiont-mediated suppression of host MAPK signal transduction pathway

definition: A process in which a symbiont interferes with, inhibits or disrupts a MAPK signal transduction pathway in its host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of host MAPK cascade
